title: 2. Character Relationship Mapping System
use_cases: Use when mapping complex character networks in multi-POV novels
Implement when tracking the progression of romantic or antagonistic arcs
Configure when defining formal hierarchies like Mentor/Student or Professional ties
Use when visualizing blood bonds and family trees for sagas
Configure when documenting how conflicts shift from current to past status
content:
Visualize complex character dynamics with structured relationship tracking.

Track 8 relationship types with strength ratings, status monitoring, and evolution notes. See how characters connect, conflict, and change throughout your story with color-coded relationship cards that make complex dynamics crystal clear.

#### 8 Relationship Types

- Family: Parents, siblings, relatives with blood bonds
- Romantic: Love interests, partners, past relationships
- Friendship: Close friends, allies, confidants
- Professional: Colleagues, business partners, co-workers
- Antagonistic: Enemies, adversaries, opposing forces
- Mentor/Student: Teachers, guides, apprentices
- Rivalry: Competitors, rivals, challengers
- Acquaintance: Casual connections, background characters

#### Advanced Tracking

- Strength Scale: 1-10 rating from weak to very strong bonds
- Status Monitoring: Past, Current, Developing, or Ended
- Evolution Notes: Track how relationships change over time
- Visual Cards: Color-coded for instant recognition
- Bidirectional: Define relationships from both perspectives

#### Writer Benefits

- Never lose track of complex character dynamics
- Plan relationship arcs alongside plot arcs
- Perfect for ensemble casts and multi-POV novels
- Ideal for romance, family sagas, and political intrigue
